quantiles: Nearest rank; primary browser and HTTP-burst groups have n10, extra feature groups n6, so p95=max; HTTP per-request groups have 10/20/40 observations by reader count. Source is first navigation in a fresh browser context, including rows whose later destination is warm. No success-only filtering.
sourceAccounting: Source observation includes existing bounded drain; late pending request bytes are unavailable, so source body bytes are observed totals, not proof of full eventual accounting. Complete font transfers are counted independently.
pairedWaitAccounting: sourcePlusClickMs is each row source useful duration plus its later click duration; excludes source bounded-drain time, deliberate warm visit and navigation preparation. It is a derived sum of two loading waits, not an uninterrupted wall-clock or sum of percentiles.

local.interactionTransportScope: Timed samples only; preparation script errors recorded separately, other preparation network accounting unavailable.

constrained.interactionTransportScope: Timed samples only; preparation script errors recorded separately, other preparation network accounting unavailable.
